title: Send email with AI Inbx
description: Send email from your domains or connected Gmail and Outlook mailboxes, and follow up in the same thread, schedule it, or draft it for review.

environment.name: AI_INBX_API_KEY
environment.description: API key from aiinbx.com/app with the sending scope. Keep this server-side.

environment.name: AI_INBX_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: Random token (at least 32 characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32) callers send as Authorization: Bearer <token>; required because Neon Function URLs are public.

operations.title: Send an email
operations.description: POST an AI Inbx send request: from, to, subject, and html or text; optionally thread_id to follow up, scheduled_at to send later, or draft to hold it for review.
